newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Pico buys HK$97 mln office property.
newsitem.headline: HK's Pico buys HK$97 mln office property.

text.p: Exhibition stands designer and maker Pico Far East Holdings Ltd has agreed to buy six office floors of a 23-storey office tower in Wanchai for HK$97.09 million, the company said in a statement on Friday.
The company said it bought the property from third parties Asia Gain Ltd and Evermost Enterprises Ltd.
A deposit of HK$9.71 million has been paid and the balance is payable on completion of deal on April 4, 1997, it said.
Pico said it would fund the purchase by internal resources and bank borrowings.
The property, covering a total gross floor area of 15,450 sq. ft. in Sinopec Building at 66 Gloucester Road, will be used as office to cope with the company's expansion, it said.
